title: Simple shift: hockey to music
description: Format example owned by A0; A2 adds the other scenarios. Two friends talk about last night's hockey game, then move to a concert. Expect exactly two level-1 nodes joined by one flow edge, boundary at u6 (utterance ids are u1, u2, … in file order).

utterances.text: Did you catch the Canucks game last night? That overtime was unreal.
I watched the third period at the pub. The goalie stole that game, honestly.
Thirty-eight saves. And the power play finally worked, two goals on three chances.
If they keep that up they might actually make the playoffs this year.
Don't jinx it. Every year we say that and every year it falls apart in March.
Fair. Okay, totally different thing, are you still going to the concert Friday?
Yes! I finally got floor tickets. The opener is that indie band from Victoria.
Oh I love them. Their new album is so much moodier than the last one.
Right? I think the producer changed. The synths sound way more like the eighties now.
I might try to get a resale ticket. Text me if anyone in your group drops out.
